verdict.rationale: Drata has a dedicated Risk Assessment feature and a Risks API (List Risks) plus Controls linkage via the API, and a Policy Center for treatment/policy docs, suggesting risks, controls, and policies are tracked together. However, evidence does not explicitly confirm scored risk registers with owners, treatment plans, or review cycles tied to controls beyond a single help article and API list endpoint. missing for 10: documentation on risk scoring methodology, treatment plan workflows, owner assignment, and review cycle scheduling tied explicitly to controls.
